final_candidates.decision_summary: Glycine at a structurally conserved position replaced by proline is never seen in homologs and has extremely poor backbone compatibility, strongly disrupting folding.
Proline substitution at Gly31 is absent in all homologs and nearly incompatible with the backbone, making it a highly disruptive folding knockout.
Buried phenylalanine swapped to charged lysine is rare in nature and poorly accommodated by the structure, destabilizing the hydrophobic core and impairing folding.
